notes: A correction release with two honest repairs behind it. The public evidence line had drifted from the site it describes: it still quoted the previous locale-key, capability-document and module counts, and the site's own badge and fact chip disagreed about the module count. The numbers now match what the product actually ships, and a new site check compares the badge with the fact chip so the two can never drift apart again. Two defects are fixed. The learned-memory write path had no cross-process lock, so two simultaneous learns could each read the file and one would erase the other's entry; the write now runs under the same bounded POSIX lock the ledger and the fleet ledger use, and the lock file lives in the per-profile state root so it never lands in a tracked directory. And the portability paths now honour the memory tombstone ledger: an import or a memory sync can no longer bring back a source the owner suppressed on the product side, while the owner's own external copy keeps its original bytes. A restore now says what it did: how many entries the local ledger filtered, how many the set travelling with the backup filtered, and — when a backup carries no suppression set and this profile has none — an honest warning that a source forgotten elsewhere could not be kept out. Six capability documents are added (47 in total), and the speech page no longer claims a chat endpoint fallback that stopped existing in the previous release. No new credential, no new outbound path, no change to any shared gateway.
